generate_passage_embeddings: run the script to generate dense embeddings for passages from a TSV file using a Contriever model
embed_passages_batched: create a function that batch-encodes passages with a tokenizer and model, returning ids and embeddings
embed_passages_with_title: run embed_passages to encode passage text combined with its title using a Contriever model
embed_passages_normalized: run embed_passages with text normalization and lowercasing applied before encoding passages
save_embeddings_pickle: run the main function to generate and save passage embeddings as a pickle file with shard support
